Use structured GitHub scopes in Turn account resolution

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-5
  description: |-
    Replace string repository_scope in Channel Turn MCP authorization with a versioned {kind, name} scope, and select GitHub accounts by exact configured repository route, owning-organization route, then Owner-only dynamic evidence.
    
    Persist an explicit account before execution so auto cannot survive durable plans. Public reachability never selects an account; equal-authority aliases fail closed with a bounded ambiguity error. Execution provisions the planned account and structured scope without reselection.
